title: Retire tests/benchmark/precision.ts
description:
Delete `tests/benchmark/precision.ts` and retarget `tests/benchmark/corpus-precision.spec.ts` at the canonical evaluator.

`score.ts` already computes precision over per-layer scope buckets, so a thin wrapper would have no remaining logic. What dies with the file: exact-key-only matching, raw string path compare, no `review_state` filter (it counts the 75 `proposed` annotations as accepted gold while `to-eval-cases.ts` defaults to accepted only), no layer tags, and the cross-layer scope defect fixed separately.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on develop via PR #33 (retire tests/benchmark/precision.ts).
